boundary: All C6-local numeric results are analytic/synthetic/reference mechanisms. Groq is 8b_proxy_for_4b and untrained in Clay. Reused branch results are inherited evidence, not independent replication. No experiment here establishes target Qwen3-4B full-fine-tune behavior.

experiments.mechanism: Failure sensitivity model 1-(1-q)*(1-p)^n where q is common semantic/compiler failure, p per conversion-boundary failure and n semantic translation boundaries.
experiments.interpretation: Reducing semantic conversion boundaries removes a multiplicative class of mismatch risk. It does not reduce q: after unification, a shared Clay/compiler/ontology error becomes proportionally more important. Numbers are sensitivity examples, not observed FRANK rates.

ClayVector basis/axis/unit/version typing catches semantic-shape mismatches that bare arrays cannot, and payload hashes catch corruption. Neither detects a trusted computation that produces the wrong value and validly rehashes it; causal/invariant checks remain necessary.

experiments.assumption: Illustrative ClayVector binary layout = 64-byte semantic header + float32 payload.
experiments.interpretation: Owner-fixed 'all values/vectors are Clay' should mean Clay semantic identity and typing, not literal textualization. High-dimensional physical payloads should remain tensors/binary while their semantic header is Clay-native.

Stable global semantics plus per-view handles/role labels can remove repeated schema/entity text before model exposure. This is byte compactness only; Qwen tokenizer fertility and target latency remain unmeasured.

experiments.conditions: 4 epistemic statuses x 2 selector-integrity states x 3 effect classes
experiments.policy: READ_ONLY may consume explicitly untrusted/unknown associative material; effectful paths require CURRENT record semantics plus VALID selection and ordinary capability checks.
experiments.interpretation: Clay can remain cognitively rich without making every activated memory authoritative. Epistemic type and effect class must survive semantic unification.

Basis/schema/version hashes can eliminate stale compiled Clay in this construction; they cannot certify the semantics of a buggy but internally consistent compiler. C6 therefore requires differential/property validation of critical Clay lowering passes.

The reference architecture can keep Needle as the sole route-class source while translating its result into immutable Clay semantics; model/memory cannot silently override route class. This says nothing about Needle classification accuracy—wrong Needle output remains a Needle error.
A self-representing Clay architecture can expose mutable research/tuning fields without making owner/authority invariants self-authorizing. This validates the toy policy, not the production compiler.

experiments.result: 30k-node synthetic graph: eager dense activation decay median 1.098 ms vs lazy touched-node 0.0280 ms; final active ~5.2%.
experiments.interpretation: Supports feasibility of a sparse between-call Clay activation field, not cognitive benefit.

experiments.source: Clay G9 EPOCH direct gold audit
experiments.result: raw state 6/10 at 487 prompt tokens vs trusted compiled candidate view 8/10 at 324 prompt tokens (-33.47%).
experiments.interpretation: Even in an all-Clay target, deterministic view compilation remains architecturally useful; target full-fine-tuned 4B remains untested.

experiments.result: Constructed null had true direct workspace effect 0; bundled graph+workspace+projection contrast ~0.2396 local/~0.2398 Judge0 while clean workspace intervention recovered 0.
experiments.interpretation: Shared Clay semantics do not merge causal stages; graph prior, workspace selection, projection and re-entry must stay independently intervenable.

experiments.result: Independent-latest multi-epoch construction produced ~8.96% invalid basis tuples; required compatibility checking accepted zero constructed mixed tuples; alias/dispatch closure counterexamples separately reproduced direction on Judge0.
experiments.interpretation: Same-language state does not remove temporal/causal consistency or resource-identity requirements.

experiments.result: At 12k relation instances, pairwise-flattened role lookup precision ~0.206 vs exact relation-instance role-aware 1.0 by construction; Judge0 reproduced pairwise direction.
experiments.interpretation: Clay-native relation representation should preserve n-ary role identity; linguistic unification cannot recover information discarded by representation.
